description: This Java class implements a configuration for statistics, named DefaultStatisticsConfig, which includes settings like timeouts, update intervals, expiration durations, and shard configurations. It provides methods to load configuration from a Typesafe Config object and implements common methods such as equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultStatisticsConfig
classes.description: Immutable configuration class implementing StatisticsConfig and WithConfigPath, encapsulating timeout, interval, expiration, and shard settings for statistics.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultStatisticsConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getDetailsExpireAfter
methods.description: Returns the expiration duration after which details are considered stale.

methods.name: getShards
methods.description: Returns the list of shard configurations.
